visual_action: A woman stands between two American flags in front of a blue background. On-screen text asks, "are you even patriotic?". She smiles and opens her black blazer to reveal a white t-shirt featuring a blue graphic of Joe Biden's face. The eyes on the graphic are glowing red. The numbers '20' and '24' are printed on either side of his head on the shirt.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: A graphic of his face is featured prominently on the t-shirt, alongside the years '20 24'.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official account '@democrats'.

cast.name: unnamed woman
cast.evidence: She is the individual featured in the video performing the reveal of the t-shirt.

spoken_summary: In response to the on-screen question, a deep, slightly distorted male voice says, "Hell yes, I am."
audio_music: A modern, upbeat hip-hop track, identified as 'American spangled banger', plays throughout the clip. The track is overlaid with a spoken line of dialogue at the beginning.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot focused on the woman's action.
manipulation_or_satire: The graphic of Joe Biden on the t-shirt has been digitally altered to make his eyes glow red, a visual element of the 'Dark Brandon' meme.
central_claim: Supporting Joe Biden for president in 2024 is a patriotic act.
intended_effect: To energize supporters by framing their vote for Biden as a confident and patriotic act, using a popular online meme.
